verdict.rationale: Crossmint's evidence covers buyer-side agent payment controls: delegated signer keys bound to user-approved permissions, scoped one-time agent cards over Visa VIC and Mastercard Agent Pay, and signed x402/MPP payment proofs. None of it documents a merchant-facing way to verify an agent's identity, such as registered agent profiles, identity signatures, or trust tiers that separate trusted agent traffic from anonymous bots. Payment authorization and spend scoping are adjacent features and earn no credit for agent identification.
